claim: C1 operability capability: executor-source-pin gate passes exactly 24 independently executed committed-object fixtures (six classes times four path spellings), with a skipped-work and always-accept control failing.
interface: python3 TOOL --repo REPO --trusted COMMIT --candidate COMMIT --path PATH [--path PATH ...]

exit_map.0: all declared regular executable-source blobs equal trusted blobs
exit_map.1: EXECUTOR_SOURCE_DRIFT: a declared source differs or is missing/nonregular at candidate
exit_map.2: EXECUTOR_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: bad arguments, invalid trusted commit/source or unresolvable candidate

trust_boundary: Trusted revision and complete source closure are supplied by verifier. This gate checks declared Git blobs only, not execution, dependencies, interpreter identity, completeness of closure, or author-independent trust. It is a binding prerequisite, not round-58 C2 certification.
